cases.sentence: Громко взываю я к ___, громко Господа умоляю.
cases.translation: Loudly I cry to the Lord; loudly I plead with the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Перед Ним я излил свою ___ и открыл Ему свою скорбь.
cases.translation: Before Him I poured out my complaint and revealed to Him my trouble.
cases.explain: The transitive verb излил (poured out) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда изнемогал во мне ___, ты знал мой путь.
cases.translation: When my spirit grew faint within me, You knew my path.
cases.explain: Дух (spirit) is the subject of the clause, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: На дороге, по которой я шел, тайно поставили для меня ___.
cases.translation: On the path I walk, they have secretly set a snare for me.
cases.explain: The verb поставили (set) with the meaning 'placed' governs the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: Я смотрю вокруг, ища своего ___, но вижу, что никому нет до меня дела.
cases.translation: I look around for my defender, but I see that no one cares about me.
cases.explain: The verb ищу (seek) in Russian often governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Взываю я к ___, Господи, и говорю, ты мое убежище.
cases.translation: I cry to You, Lord, and say: You are my refuge.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Освободи меня из ___, чтобы я вознес хвалу имени твоему.
cases.translation: Free me from prison, so that I may praise Your name.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Сохрани меня от ___, которые раскинули для меня.
cases.translation: Keep me from the snares they have set for me.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Громко взываю я к Господу, громко Господа умоляю.
reading.question: How does the psalmist address the Lord?
reading.explain: The verse opens: Громко взываю я к Господу, громко Господа умоляю (Loudly I cry to the Lord; loudly I plead with the Lord).

reading.ru: Когда изнемогал во мне дух, ты знал мой путь.
reading.question: What does the psalmist say about God's knowledge?
options: God knew his path even when his spirit was failing
God was unaware of his struggles
God learned his path from others
reading.correct: God knew his path even when his spirit was failing
reading.explain: The text states: Когда изнемогал во мне дух, ты знал мой путь (When my spirit grew faint, You knew my path).

reading.ru: На дороге, по которой я шел, тайно поставили для меня сеть.
reading.question: What danger was set against the psalmist?
options: A snare secretly placed on his path
reading.correct: A snare secretly placed on his path
reading.explain: The verse says: на дороге ... тайно поставили для меня сеть (on the path, they secretly set a snare for me).

reading.ru: Я смотрю вокруг, ища своего защитника, но вижу, что никому нет до меня дела.
reading.question: What does the psalmist observe when he looks for help?
options: No one cares about him or acts as his defender
reading.correct: No one cares about him or acts as his defender
reading.explain: The text shows: ища своего защитника ... никому нет до меня дела (looking for my defender, but no one cares about me).

reading.ru: Взываю я к тебе, Господи, и говорю, ты мое убежище и мой удел в земле живых.
reading.question: What does the psalmist declare about the Lord?
options: The Lord is his refuge and his portion in the land of the living
The Lord is distant and uncaring
The Lord will punish his enemies
The Lord expects him to fight alone
reading.correct: The Lord is his refuge and his portion in the land of the living
reading.explain: The psalmist declares: ты мое убежище и мой удел в земле живых (You are my refuge and my portion in the land of the living).

reading.ru: Сохрани меня от сетей, которые раскинули для меня, и от западни злодеев.
reading.question: What protection does the psalmist ask for?
options: Protection from snares and traps set by evildoers
reading.correct: Protection from snares and traps set by evildoers
reading.explain: The request is: Сохрани меня от сетей ... и от западни злодеев (Keep me from the snares and from the traps of evildoers).
